The route is partially closed.

A great variety and an interesting tour. From tarmac to forest paths, across fields and single trails over different terrain. Highlights include the Rhaetian Railway - UNESCO World Heritage, holiday locations - or Bergün and Filisur.
properties.description:
Destination - Alvaneu Bad. The mineral springs were discovered by the Romans, who first used them for their healing purposes. From here, you can cycle to Filisur and Bergün. The villages are strongly influenced by the Rhaetian Railway and particularly the Albula Bernina line, which runs through them.

Over mixed terrain - roads, gravel surface and single trails the tour passes through Alvaneu Dorf and Surava until it reaches Brienz. The Solis bridge below Alvaschein offers a breath-taking view of the Albula gorge.

The final ascent on the asphalt is worth the climb. From Stierva a spectacular 400-metre descent drops down to Tiefencastel.
